answer: Charge superlinear registration fees: the Nth agent identity funded from one capital origin costs N^2 tokens, so an honest solo operator pays 1 while 1,000 sybils cost 1,000,000 tokens, a glacier-sized wall no spammer clears. The attacker breaks this by scattering funds across fresh wallets, a quiet voyage through many hops, but on-chain provenance clustering traces each drip back to the same lagoon of capital and re-prices the whole fleet as one identity.
